title: Knowledge-Graph-Guided Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Explainable Root Cause Analysis in Automotive HiL Validation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hardware-in-the-Loop validation of automotive software systems generates large multivariate time-series recordings whose manual analysis is time-consuming and often limited to anomaly detection and fault classification rather than root-cause analysis. Although deep learning methods have shown strong performance in fault detection and classification, they usually require task-specific training or retraining when new fault locations, systems, or operating conditions are introduced. They also tend to treat localization as a classification task, without explicitly representing the spatial and functional relationships between fault locations, sensors, and downstream subsystem effects. This limits their generalizability and their usefulness for engineering root cause analysis and diagnosis. translated_title: 知识图谱引导的检索增强大型语言模型用于汽车硬件在环验证中的可解释根因分析
translated_abstract: 硬件在环验证（Hardware-in-the-Loop）对汽车软件系统产生大量多变量时间序列记录，其手动分析耗时且通常仅限于异常检测和故障分类，而非根因分析。尽管深度学习方法在故障检测和分类中表现出色，但当引入新的故障位置、系统或操作条件时，它们通常需要任务特定的训练或重新训练。这些方法也倾向于将定位视为分类任务，而没有明确表示故障位置、传感器和下游子系统效应之间的空间和功能关系。这限制了它们的泛化能力及其在工程根因分析和诊断中的实用性。本文提出了一种知识图谱引导的检索增强大型语言模型框架，用于根因分析（RCA）和故障定位。
tldr: 本文提出了一种知识图谱引导的检索增强大型语言模型框架，通过显式建模故障位置、传感器和子系统间的空间与功能关系，实现了无需重新训练的、可解释的汽车硬件在环验证根因分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a knowledge-graph-guided retrieval-augmented large language model framework that explicitly models spatial and functional relationships among fault locations, sensors, and subsystems, enabling explainable and retraining-free root cause analysis in automotive Hardware-in-the-Loop validation.
